name: Mansfield
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Mansfield, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Mansfield, MA: the South Common tree lighting with Santa and Mrs. Claus, plus the Downtown Christmas Parade.
lede: In Mansfield, the holiday season starts on the South Common, where a Christmas parade leads to the town's tree lighting and a visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus.
celebrates: Mansfield kicks off its holiday season with the Parks and Recreation Department's Tree Lighting Ceremony on the South Common at Six Park Row. The Downtown Business Association runs a Christmas parade that begins on the North Common, and Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive at the South Common afterward to count down to the first tree lighting of the season. Children can share their gift requests with Santa, pick up candy canes and warm up with hot chocolate from the Mansfield Elks Club while supplies last.
lastyear: The town's own Facebook posts show how long this tradition has run. The Parks and Recreation Department held its Tree Lighting Ceremony on Sunday, November 27, 2022, at 4 pm on the South Common, and invited families to come out and join the celebration. Tree lighting night has long centered on the South Common, and the 2026 flyer again has Santa and Mrs. Claus arriving for the countdown and children invited to visit with them once the tree is lit.
facts: Mansfield is celebrating its 250th anniversary in 2026, and the town's events page lists a Grand Parade on Saturday, May 17, at 11 am, rain or shine, with marching bands, horses and more. The town also has two commons, North and South, and the holiday parade and the tree lighting use both: the parade begins on the North Common and the lighting is held on the South Common. The Xfinity Center, the outdoor amphitheater on South Main Street, opened in 1986 as Great Woods.
trains: Mansfield is on the MBTA Commuter Rail Providence/Stoughton Line. Mansfield station, at 1 Crocker Street, is in Zone 6 and has trains to South Station in Boston and to Providence, so families can ride into Boston for holiday events without driving. A few more train attractions are within reach: Lowell has the Boston and Maine Railroad Historical Society's steam locomotive No. 410 and the National Streetcar Museum, and Edaville in Carver runs a Holiday Express train through Christmas lights.

faq: Where is the Mansfield tree lighting held?

The Parks and Recreation Department holds its Tree Lighting Ceremony on the South Common at Six Park Row. Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive for the countdown to the first tree lighting of the holiday season, and children are invited to share their gift requests with them afterward.
What time is the Mansfield Christmas parade?

The Downtown Business Association's Christmas Parade begins on the North Common ahead of the tree lighting. Santa and Mrs. Claus then arrive at the South Common for the lighting at about 4 pm. Check the 2026 event page for the date and times.
Does Mansfield have a train station?

Yes. Mansfield station, at 1 Crocker Street, is on the MBTA Commuter Rail Providence/Stoughton Line, with trains to South Station in Boston and to Providence. It is in Zone 6, and the MBTA lists parking at the station.
Where can kids see a Christmas train near Mansfield?

Edaville in Carver runs a Holiday Express train through Christmas lights, and Lowell has the Boston and Maine Railroad Historical Society and the National Streetcar Museum, which are linked on this page.
Who runs the Mansfield tree lighting?

The Mansfield Parks and Recreation Department runs the Tree Lighting Ceremony, and the Downtown Business Association runs the Christmas parade that comes before it. The Mansfield Elks Club serves the hot chocolate.
